meta.name: Bleach — Concentrated + Hollowed
meta.description: Manga-paced Bleach: Concentrated Bleach by Gabby, followed by Hollowed Bleach by Knight, including the two recommended specials. Japanese audio with English subtitles preferred; dual audio and English dub alternatives. Four arcs in guide order. No API keys.
